description: Google Drive as the signed-in Workspace user: search, read, write, and share files, never delete them for good — Staff documents for alice

guide.summary: Each caller's Drive files, bounded content, recoverable trash and quiet sharing.
guide.content:
# Google Drive usage

Connection purpose: Staff documents for alice

Acts as the Workspace user deployment config maps from the admitted caller or pool owner. No caller argument selects an account. An unmapped or ownerless caller has no access unless the deployment fixes a shared account.

## Finding files and joining Workspace products

Drive searches file data; operation discovery searches API capabilities.
Use file ids from reads, Drive URLs or the person: an id they give, such as
`pdf1`, works as is. The same id identifies a Google Doc,
Sheet, Slides deck or Form in its product connector. Shared-drive ids identify
membership and the root folder; folder parents determine inherited access.
A missing file and a file the delegated user cannot see fail alike.

Drive query values use single quotes: `name contains 'budget'`,
`mimeType = 'application/pdf'`, `'folder_123' in parents`, or
`modifiedTime > '2026-01-01T00:00:00'`. Trashed files are excluded by default.
`incompleteSearch: true` means Google did not search every corpus; narrow the
query or choose a single shared drive. It is never an exact count.

`maxBytes` is the byte budget and `limit` is rows per page; keep a high limit
for large folders and continue with the same listing arguments. Named `fields`
may narrow and `maxBytes` may change between pages. Hatch paths omit `/drive/v3`.

## Content and file decisions

The content workflow exports Docs as Markdown, Sheets as CSV of the first
sheet only, and Slides as text. Other text files retain their declared charset.
Small binary files can be returned as base64. A drawing, unsupported native
file, folder, shortcut or oversized binary returns an unavailable explanation.
For a shortcut, read its target id instead. Drive exports at most 10 MB.

Content containing sent credentials is withheld as a whole binary value; there
is no partial-content recovery around that boundary. Withheld MIME, shortcut,
folder or parent metadata cannot decide a subsequent read or move. Re-read
through a safe source before trying the workflow again.

## Access and recovery

A file or copy inherits its destination folder's access. Read permission holders
before moving, copying or creating in a shared folder, and read them again after
changing access. Inherited permissions name the parent folder or shared drive
that must be changed instead. An owner cannot be removed or replaced here.

All new grants use `share_file`, which sends no notification email by default.
Confirm intent before granting `anyone` or domain access. Permission creation
through the hatch is refused, including public-link grants; the named workflow
owns grantee validation and notification behavior.

Content updates replace the complete content. A create with an uncertain outcome
needs a search for the intended file before another create. Recoverable trash
can be restored for 30 days. Permanent deletion, ownership transfer, watch
registration, credential minting and generic media transport are outside the
hatch. Use the named content and upload workflows for bounded bytes.

## Conventions

- **Paging:** while `page.hasMore` is true, continue with `page.nextCursor` unchanged. For `drive_api_details`, `drive_api_read`, `drive_api_search`, `list_folder_items`, `list_permissions`, `list_shared_drives`, `search_files`, pass it as the top-level `cursor`; omit raw paging anchors on continuations. Keep the original method, path, filters, page size, fields and headers. Paged `list_*` and `search_*` reads take `limit` (default 25, at most 100). The last page has no `nextCursor`. If `page.hasMore` is true without a cursor, the data is incomplete and continuation was withheld. When approaching execute_code's per-program call limit, return page.nextCursor before the call that would exceed it and continue in the next program; don't restart.
- **Results:** `fields` narrows a read's result to the dot paths you name. `truncated` lists the dot paths a result cut for size; the ids that fetch what was cut stay in the result.
- **Hatch:** `drive_api_search` finds this API's operations and reads no account data, `drive_api_details` shows one operation's contract, and `drive_api_read` calls a reviewed read. `drive_api_write` calls a reviewed write; the host may ask the user to confirm it. An operation without a reviewed verdict is refused. 51 operations are refused by design; use `drive_api_details` with the method and path to inspect an operation's contract and refusal.
- **Writes:** a write is sent once and never retried. When its outcome is unknown, read the target before repeating it. Writes take no idempotency key.
- **Errors:** codes come from the vendor's statuses and error facts, never its prose. An unknown id, or one these credentials cannot reach, fails as `connector_call_failed`; this API does not tell the two apart. `conflict` means: A Drive source page changed before its local cursor resumed.
- **Withheld values:** a value withheld for safety reads `"[redacted]"`. Writes refuse whole marker values and withheld links; longer prose may mention the marker. Paths and queries refuse any containment.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search Drive files the user can open with Drive query syntax, returning name, type, folder, size, and link per file. Content needs get_file_content.

query.description: Drive query: name contains 'budget', fullText contains 'elders', mimeType = 'application/pdf', modifiedTime > '2026-01-01T00:00:00', 'me' in owners. Omit for everything.

corpora.description: Where to look: user (default; My Drive and shared with me), drive (one shared drive, with driveId), allDrives (slower, may be incomplete), domain.

driveId.description: Shared drive id from list_shared_drives; required with corpora drive, refused otherwise.

orderBy.description: Sort order. Drive refuses any sort on a fullText query, which comes back by relevance.

includeTrashed.description: Include trashed files, which are left out by default.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100; defaults to 25. Connecta's cap, below Drive's 1,000.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged with the same arguments.

maxBytes.description: Serialized bytes of the whole result; defaults to 196608, what execute_code can receive. Raise it, to 4194304, only for a direct call_tool read.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item; only narrows the result.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

folderId.description: Folder id, a shared drive id for its top level, or root for My Drive.

orderBy.description: Sort order; defaults to folders first, then by name.

includeTrashed.description: Include trashed files, which are left out by default.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100; defaults to 25. Connecta's cap, below Drive's 1,000.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged with the same arguments.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Get one Drive file's metadata: name, type, folder, owners, sharing flag, description, and what this user may do with it. Never its content.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result; only narrows the result.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Read a Drive file's content: Docs as Markdown, Sheets as CSV of the first sheet, Slides as text, text files as text, small binaries as base64. Never drawings or folders.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

maxChars.description: Characters (code points) of text kept, 1 to 100000; defaults to 20000. Longer text ends with a truncation marker. Binaries ignore it.

maxBytes.description: Serialized bytes of the whole result; defaults to 196608, what execute_code can receive. Raise it, to 4194304, only for a direct call_tool read.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result; only narrows the result.

tools.description: List who a Drive file or folder is shared with: each permission's id, type, role, and address or domain. Use the ids with update_permission or delete_permission.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100; defaults to 25. Connecta's cap, below Drive's 1,000.

tools.description: List the shared drives the user is a member of, with their ids for search_files and list_folder_items. Not the files inside them.

query.description: Shared drive query, e.g. name contains 'Finance'. Omit for every drive.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new, empty Drive folder, in My Drive or inside another folder. Shares nothing beyond what the parent folder already grants.

name.description: File name as Drive shows it, extension included where it has one.

parentId.description: Folder id to place it in, or root for My Drive; defaults to My Drive.

description.description: Free-text description shown in Drive's details pane.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create a Drive file from text or base64 content, or an empty one; convertTo makes a Google Doc, Sheet, or Slides file. Whoever can see its folder can see it.

name.description: File name as Drive shows it, extension included where it has one.

parentId.description: Folder id to place it in, or root for My Drive; defaults to My Drive.

content.description: Text content, up to 1000000 characters (connecta's cap). Exclusive with contentBase64.

contentBase64.description: Binary content as base64, up to 1048576 bytes decoded (connecta's cap; Drive allows 5 MB). Exclusive with content.

mimeType.description: Media type of the content: text/plain, text/markdown, text/csv, application/pdf. Never a Google type. Defaults to text/plain or application/octet-stream.

convertTo.description: Import as a Google type: markdown, HTML, or text to document; CSV to spreadsheet. Without content, an empty one.

description.description: Free-text description shown in Drive's details pane.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: update_file_content
tools.description: Replace a Drive file's entire content with new text or base64 bytes; the old content survives only in Drive's version history. Keeps name, folder, and sharing.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

content.description: Text content, up to 1000000 characters (connecta's cap). Exclusive with contentBase64.

contentBase64.description: Binary content as base64, up to 1048576 bytes decoded (connecta's cap; Drive allows 5 MB). Exclusive with content.

mimeType.description: Media type of the new content: usually the file's own, text/markdown for a Google Doc, text/csv for a Sheet (replacing every tab).

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: update_file
tools.description: Rename a Drive file or folder, or replace its description. Never its content, folder, or sharing: use update_file_content, move_file, or share_file.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

name.description: File name as Drive shows it, extension included where it has one.

description.description: Free-text description shown in Drive's details pane.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move a Drive file or folder into another folder or shared drive, out of the folder it is in now. Can change who has access to it.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

folderId.description: Destination folder id, a shared drive id for its top level, or root for My Drive.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy a Drive file into a new file, optionally renamed or in another folder. The copy is shared like its folder, not like the original; no folders.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

name.description: Name of the copy; defaults to Drive's "Copy of …".

parentId.description: Folder for the copy; defaults to the original's.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: trash_file
tools.description: Move a Drive file or folder to the trash, where Drive deletes it for good after 30 days; restore_file undoes it. Never deletes permanently itself.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: restore_file
tools.description: Restore (untrash) a trashed Drive file or folder to where it was. Cannot recover a file already deleted from the trash.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a Drive file or folder with a user, group, domain, or anyone with the link, at a role up to writer. Sends no email unless asked; never transfers ownership.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

type.description: Grantee kind: user or group needs emailAddress, domain needs domain, anyone means anyone with the link.

role.description: Access granted. fileOrganizer and organizer exist only on shared drives. Ownership is never granted here.

emailAddress.description: The user's or group's email address, for type user or group only.

domain.description: The Workspace domain, for type domain only.

allowFileDiscovery.description: For domain or anyone: whether it appears in search rather than needing the link. Defaults to false.

sendNotificationEmail.description: Email a user or group that it was shared. Defaults to false; Drive requires it for a non-Google address.

emailMessage.description: Message in the notification email; only with sendNotificationEmail true.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: update_permission
tools.description: Change the role of one existing share on a Drive file or folder. Never makes anyone an owner; an inherited share is changed on the folder it comes from.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

role.description: Access granted. fileOrganizer and organizer exist only on shared drives. Ownership is never granted here.

truncated.description: Fields this result shortened (a string ending in …), capped (a list past ten), or left out (a malformed id). get_file keeps longer names.

tools.name: delete_permission
tools.description: Remove one share from a Drive file or folder, revoking that user's, group's, domain's, or link's access. Never deletes the file; an owner cannot be removed.

fileId.description: File or folder id, from search_files, list_folder_items, or a Drive URL's /d/<id>.

tools.name: drive_api_search
tools.description: Find Google Drive API operations by keyword or path. Returns up to 8 compact matches with the tool that calls each; reads no account data.

query.description: Keywords or a path, e.g. refund charge.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous search with the same query.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

matched.description: The request or response field this operation was found by; call its tool to read the field.

truncated.description: Entry labels cut for size; drive_api_details on that method and path returns them whole.

tools.name: drive_api_details
tools.description: Read one Google Drive API operation's request contract: path, query and body parameters with types and required names. Reads no account data.

path.description: The path template from search, or a concrete path.

param.description: Return only this parameter, in full.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous details call with the same method, path and param.

body.description: Body content type and schema. When paged: this page's properties, the required names it delivers or chunks, and the schema's other keywords on the page that carries them.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

of.description: The piece this text belongs to, such as parameters.limit.

text.description: Part of that piece's JSON; join the parts in page order, then parse them.

truncated.description: Labels cut for size; their full text arrives as chunks.

page.description: Present when the contract exceeds one answer: pass nextCursor back for the next pieces.

tools.name: drive_api_read
tools.description: Call a reviewed Google Drive API read. The operation index checks arguments before anything is sent.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /files/file_123. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor from this same read; omit raw query anchors when continuing.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.

param.description: Vendor parameter restored from cursor; pass nextCursor as the top-level cursor.

tools.name: drive_api_write
tools.description: Call a reviewed Google Drive API write; method and path are stated for approval, and the operation index checks arguments first.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /files/file_123. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

body.description: Request body as JSON fields, named as details lists them; form operations are encoded for you.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.
